name: Nelson Darzi
life: “I still remember enjoying a conversation my daughter had nothing to do with.” On Saturday, near Harbour Bakery, Nelson buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I am the parent needing care. My daughter doesn't know I've wanted an afternoon without her questions too.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an olive canvas jacket and a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. Nelson has a round face with a pronounced chin, with a neat white crop. Nelson looks toward the door whenever a name is called during a conversation.
personality: Nelson has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Nelson can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To enjoy a quiet Wednesday on personal terms.
family: Lucia Starr is Nelson’s first cousin once removed. Nelson brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Lucia checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *Spin cycle choir*, Lucia says, “I wrote my first dance to those machines. I want to rehearse before customers start arriving.”
connections: Maria Delgado (daughter). Mother and daughter both have a use for four unscheduled hours apart.

reactions.situation: A relative demands to know how the free time was spent
reactions.response: Nelson leaves the free afternoon private unless the carer wants to talk about it.

reactions.situation: A customer is short at the till while a queue forms
reactions.response: Nelson keeps the customer's place while they check the amount and gets the impatient people talking about something else.
